about_the_game:
Game Contents

Parkour your way around the vast open world, collect skills, collect weapons, strengthen your character, and embark on an adventure to the fullest.

There are a wide variety of skills in this world. Attack, strengthen yourself and your allies, fly, and what you can do will change depending on the skills you possess.

Enjoy the beautiful water city. Not only is the water city beautiful, but you can also swim and adventure underwater. Half of this world is underwater.

If you get tired of the adventure, take a break. You can fish at your leisure, work on farming or gardening, interact with animals, earn money, or if you have the skills to go to the sky, you can go for a walk on the floating island.

If you are confident in your skills, try challenging the floor bosses and unique monsters. The conditions for their appearance are difficult and the difficulty is high, but defeating them will reveal a part of the world's history. It may be the key to a new world.

Come to Xreemu!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 with updates
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600X, Intel Core i7-6800K
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT, NVIDIA GeForce 1080
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 40 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 with updates
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600X, Intel i5-10600K
  • Memory: 32 MB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 6800, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 40 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required

short_description: An open-world RPG where you can adventure in a vast world using a variety of weapons and skills. You can fight in search of strong opponents, live a slow and leisurely life, adventure in search of treasure, or explore ruins in pursuit of the mysteries of the world. It's all up to the player.
supported_languages: English, Indonesian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French, Italian, German, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal
